status_semantics: Baseline integrated/implemented records describe the original v1 evidence, not product-v2 compatibility. amendment_status and revision_tasks record outstanding work. S1 audit is implemented and prepared for independent review; no deployment is implied.

BACKEND-LOCAL.conditional: Corrective real-service/process fault evidence, including durable uploads/readiness/GC/expiry and CREDIT; no App required. Controlled engine does not prove GPU/model performance.

BACKEND-READY.conditional: Accepted final SHA/image/profile in CREDIT mode; valid load/soak/recovery/restore/rollback and continuous operations; approved rates/workload/limits; explicit decision. Runner implementation is not acceptance. Public cutover separately recorded.

APP-LOCAL.conditional: If optional trace capture or callbacks enabled, relevant T/G5 integration suites must pass; Lab UI/judge not required. New CREDIT contracts/migrations and real consumer context required; no fixture account data.

APP-PILOT.conditional: Published rates, legacy-account cutover policy and allocated staging/GPU evidence required.

LAB-OPERATE.conditional: Staging provider access/publication/rollback evidence; no customer-content sharing without grants.

LAB-OBSERVE.conditional: Trace/data/judge workers need deployment evidence before enablement; live judge needs explicit consent/budget beyond dry-run. V1M must remove the App provider route and prove both app boundaries.

LAB-EVALUATE-LOCAL.conditional: Real local DB/object/services and UI; imported owned data works with E5L unavailable. No real model-quality or staging claim from fake endpoints.

LAB-IMPROVE-LOCAL.conditional: Second permitted data iteration, manual external training export/import and protocol-server integration; live teacher/automatic training adapters require separately approved rates/budgets and evidence.

LAB-ROLLOUT-LOCAL.conditional: Routing/control/rollback integrated locally; measured model/hardware and staging-traffic evidence are separately required for public enablement.

COMPLETE-LOCAL.conditional: All current core features built and integrated; allocated staging/live release evidence remains separate. Conditional/deferred expansions cannot be represented as complete.

COMPLETE-RELEASE.conditional: Also requires staging deployment, restore/revocation/fault evidence for every enabled feature, published rates and account transition, actual Marlin GPU parity, allocated origins and approved external adapters/data/budgets. Manual training connector may be the enabled adapter; unsupported automatic adapters stay unavailable.
